No surrounding card panel except the explicitly requested portrait frame or small result badge that is part of the subject.
SUBJECT: a compact SQUARE COMMANDER PORTRAIT enclosed in a polished GOLD BEVELED FRAME with four small silver corner bolts, matching the portrait composition in reference1. Inside the frame, a friendly stylized adult tank commander with a warm confident smile, expressive brown eyes, olive military helmet, amber goggles resting above the forehead and a dark padded headset. Commander visible head and shoulders emerging from the top hatch of a GREEN toy tank; the upper tank hull occupies lower portrait area with a small simple white five-point star. Gentle blue sky and a small white cloud are visible ONLY INSIDE the portrait frame behind the character. Tank and sky are neatly cropped by the inner square portrait window. Outside the complete gold frame is fully transparent alpha. Frame itself complete and uncropped, not touching canvas edges. No nameplate, text or extra badge. All elements fit into a cohesive square portrait, not a full-body character scene.
